note: Only what an event publishes itself: dates, focus, industry programme, submissions. Never guess dates; null means not published.

items.name: Viennale (Vienna International Film Festival)
items.focus: Austria's major international festival, presenting a curated non-competitive programme of new cinema, documentaries and retrospectives.
items.industry: Press and industry accreditation.

items.name: Sarajevo Film Festival
items.focus: The leading festival of Southeast Europe, presenting regional competition programmes and international premieres each August.
items.industry: CineLink Industry Days with the CineLink co-production market, presenting about ten regional feature projects a year.
items.submissions: Eventival (separate application per film, submission fee)

items.name: Sofia International Film Festival and Sofia Meetings
items.focus: Bulgaria's largest film festival, with international competitions for first and second features and a broad public programme (167 films from 60 countries in 2026).
items.industry: Sofia Meetings co-production market for Balkan and European projects (23rd edition ran 18 to 30 March 2026).

items.name: Karlovy Vary International Film Festival (KVIFF)
items.focus: Central Europe's leading A-list festival, held in the West Bohemian spa town, with the Crystal Globe main competition (60th edition closed 11 July 2026).
items.industry: Industry Days programme for accredited film professionals.
items.submissions: Own online Film Entry form on kviff.com (submission fee, online screeners only)

items.name: CPH:DOX
items.focus: Copenhagen's international documentary festival, with competitions, a science strand (SCIENCE:CINEMA) and a large public programme.
items.industry: CPH:INDUSTRY with the CPH:FORUM financing and co-production event, CPH:CONFERENCE and CPH:DOX SUMMIT; CPH:FORUM 2027 opens for submissions in early September 2026.
items.submissions: Own CPH:DOX profile on cphdox.dk
items.submission_deadline_note: 2027 edition: 1 September 2026 for films completed before that date, 3 November 2026 for films completed after 1 September

items.name: Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF)
items.focus: Estonia's A-list festival for feature films, with Official Selection, First Feature and Rebels with a Cause competitions, plus the Just Film youth festival and PÖFF Shorts.
items.industry: Industry@Tallinn & Baltic Event (25th edition, 9 to 20 November 2026), the region's co-production market and industry meeting.
items.submissions: Own submission portal (My BNFF) on poff.ee
items.submission_deadline_note: 30th edition: regular deadline 29 June 2026 and extended deadline 17 August 2026 for feature programmes; documentaries until 24 August 2026

items.name: Annecy International Animation Film Festival and Mifa
items.focus: The world's leading animation festival, with competitions for features, shorts, TV and commissioned films, graduation films and immersive works (over 4,000 entries in 2025).
items.industry: Mifa market, 15 to 18 June 2027, with project pitches and accreditation for buyers and professionals.
items.submissions: Own online account on annecyfestival.com for films and projects

items.name: Cartoon Movie
items.focus: Pitching and co-production forum for European animated feature projects, organised by CARTOON with support from Creative Europe MEDIA.
items.industry: Producers pitch feature projects to buyers, distributors and financiers; accreditation for registered professionals.
items.submissions: Own project application on cartoon-media.eu
items.submission_deadline_note: Project submission deadline 12 November 2026; selection announced in the week of 1 December 2026

items.name: Festival de Cannes and Marché du Film
items.focus: The most prominent A-list festival, with the Official Selection (Competition, Un Certain Regard, Cannes Classics, short films) alongside the parallel Directors' Fortnight and Critics' Week.
items.industry: Marché du Film, 11 to 19 May 2027, described by its organisers as the largest film market in the world (16,000 professionals, 4,000 films and projects); Greece is Country of Honour in 2027.
items.submissions: Own online entry form on festival-cannes.com (application and screening fee)
items.submission_deadline_note: 2027 deadlines not yet published; for 2026 the feature deadline was 13 March 2026 and short films 2 March 2026

items.name: Les Arcs Film Festival
items.focus: Festival of European cinema in the Les Arcs ski resort, with a competition of European features and public screenings.
items.industry: Industry programme for registered professionals alongside the festival.
items.submissions: Own online film registration on lesarcs-filmfest.com (professionals only)

items.name: MIPCOM Cannes
items.focus: The global content market for television and streaming at the Palais des Festivals, attended by studios, platforms, broadcasters, creators and brands.
items.industry: Market with exhibition, screenings, conference sessions and a participants directory; MIPJUNIOR precedes it.

items.name: Micro Salon AFC
items.focus: The French cinematographers' association (AFC) equipment show with post-production days, held at the Parc Floral de Paris (26th edition ran 5 to 6 February 2026).
items.industry: Manufacturers and rental houses present cameras, lighting and grip to cinematographers and crews.

items.name: SATIS
items.focus: French-language show for image and sound technologies, from production to content distribution, at the Docks de Paris.
items.industry: Exhibition with conference sessions for media, entertainment and audiovisual communication professionals.

items.name: Series Mania
items.focus: Europe's largest festival dedicated to series, with international competitions and public screenings in Lille.
items.industry: Series Mania Forum (23 to 25 March 2027, in Lille and online) with co-pro pitching sessions, Lille Dialogues and panels, plus the Series Mania Institute for training.

items.name: Sunny Side of the Doc
items.focus: International marketplace for documentary and factual content, bringing producers together with commissioners, distributors and platforms (37th edition ran 22 to 24 June 2026).
items.industry: Meet & Match call for projects, pitching sessions, Copro HUB and keynotes.
items.submissions: Own registration platform (register.sunnysideofthedoc.com) with a Meet & Match call for projects

items.name: Berlin International Film Festival (Berlinale) and European Film Market
items.focus: A-list festival with Competition, Panorama, Forum, Generation and Berlinale Series, screening new international films for the public and the trade.
items.industry: European Film Market (EFM) 10 to 16 February 2027, Berlinale Co-Production Market 13 to 16 February 2027 and Berlinale Talents 12 to 17 February 2027.
items.submissions: Own online Film Entry portal on berlinale.de (processing fee)
items.submission_deadline_note: 77th edition: 21 October 2026 for feature-length films, 4 November 2026 for short films

items.name: Berlinale Series Market
items.focus: Three-day European Film Market initiative for TV drama professionals, with keynotes, showcases and the Berlinale Series Market Selects label for new series (2026 edition ran 15 to 18 February).
items.industry: Organised with the Berlinale Co-Production Market (Co-Pro Series pitching) and Berlinale Talents; access through EFM accreditation.

items.name: FMX
items.focus: Conference on animation, effects, games and immersive media, organised by Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg in Stuttgart.
items.industry: Hosts the Animation Production Days (APD), a co-production and financing market run jointly with the Stuttgart International Festival of Animated Film.

items.name: Thessaloniki International Film Festival
items.next_dates: 5 to 15 November 2026 (67th TIFF); Thessaloniki International Documentary Festival 4 to 14 March 2027 (29th)
items.focus: Greece's main festival for new international and Balkan cinema at the Olympion, with a separate Thessaloniki International Documentary Festival each March.
items.industry: Agora industry section with the Crossroads Co-Production Forum, Agora Works in Progress and Doc Together (TiDF).
items.submissions: Own open-calls portal on filmfestival.gr
items.submission_deadline_note: TiDF29 (March 2027): submissions 19 September to 30 November 2026 (60 euro entry fee); immersive/XR projects until 8 January 2027

items.name: Cork International Film Festival
items.focus: Ireland's oldest film festival, screening international features, documentaries and a large Irish and international shorts programme.
items.industry: Industry programmes including First Take, Doc Day, IGNITE-Docs and the Lasair Irish short documentary development scheme.
items.submissions: FilmFreeway (filmfreeway.com/CorkFilmFestival)
items.submission_deadline_note: 2026 late deadlines extended to 7 August 2026 (features and international shorts) and 14 August 2026 (Irish shorts)

items.name: Galway Film Fleadh
items.focus: Ireland's leading film festival, with premieres of Irish and international features, shorts and Irish-language work (38th edition ran 7 to 12 July 2026).
items.industry: Galway Film Fair marketplace and pitching competition alongside the festival.
items.submissions: Own submissions page on galwayfilmfleadh.com; film, XR, marketplace and pitching applications for 2027 open in the new year

items.name: Torino Film Festival
items.focus: Turin's international festival of new cinema, with international competitions and retrospectives.
items.submissions: FilmFreeway (filmfreeway.com/torinofilmfest)

items.name: Trieste Film Festival and When East Meets West
items.focus: Italy's main festival for Central and Eastern European cinema, held on the Adriatic in January.
items.industry: When East Meets West (WEMW) co-production forum runs during the festival: 17th edition 17 to 19 January 2027, a pitching forum for 20 projects from Europe, North and Latin America.
items.submissions: Eventival (vp.eventival.com/trieste/2027)

items.name: VIEW Conference
items.focus: International conference on VFX, computer graphics, animation, games, virtual production and immersive media.

items.name: Venice International Film Festival (La Biennale di Venezia)
items.focus: The world's oldest film festival, held on the Lido with the Competition, Orizzonti, Venice Immersive and Venice Classics sections.
items.industry: Venice Production Bridge industry programme, including the Venice Immersive Market (3 to 9 September 2026) and Meet the Streamers sessions (6 to 7 September 2026).
items.submissions: Own online pre-selection entry form on labiennale.org (registration fee)

items.name: Cinekid Festival
items.focus: The largest children's media festival, with film, television and MediaLab programmes for young audiences in Amsterdam and across the Netherlands.
items.industry: Cinekid for Professionals with the Junior Co-production Market (18 projects from 20 countries selected for 2026), an Industry Forum and accreditation.

items.name: IBC
items.focus: Europe's largest broadcast and media technology show at RAI Amsterdam, bringing together the creative, technology and business communities.
items.industry: Exhibition plus conference programme; registration via show.ibc.org.

items.name: International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam (IDFA)
items.focus: The world's largest documentary festival, with international competitions and a broad public programme across Amsterdam.
items.industry: Industry accreditation via professionals.idfa.nl, with markets including Docs for Sale plus training and funding programmes.
items.submissions: Own portal (MyIDFA)

items.name: International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR) and CineMart
items.focus: Festival for independent and experimental cinema, with the Tiger Competition and the Art Directions programme for moving-image art.
items.industry: IFFR Pro with the CineMart co-production market, Darkroom work-in-progress platform, Lightroom Market for immersive projects and the RTM Pitch for Rotterdam filmmakers.
items.submissions: Own submission portal on iffr.com for completed films and Art Directions; separate entries for CineMart and Darkroom projects

items.name: Nederlands Film Festival (NFF)
items.focus: The national showcase for Dutch film, series, documentaries and digital culture, with the national film competitions and awards.
items.industry: NFF Professionals programme with professional passes, NFF Extended, expert sessions and the NFF Academy.
items.submissions: Own Mijn NFF account (Dutch productions)
items.submission_deadline_note: 2026 edition closed; round 2 deadline was 1 April 2026 for productions completed between 1 April and 21 May 2026

items.name: Camerimage (International Film Festival ToruńCAMERIMAGE)
items.focus: International festival devoted to the art of cinematography, with competitions, seminars and equipment exhibitions at the CKK Jordanki centre.
items.industry: Entry cards for cinematographers, students and industry representatives (pre-sale 24 August to 24 October 2026); press accreditation through the Camerimage Portal.
items.submissions: Own Camerimage Portal (calls for student etudes, pilot episodes and music videos)
items.submission_deadline_note: Student etudes, pilot episodes and music videos for 2026: 31 July 2026 (no fee)

items.name: Krakow Film Festival
items.focus: One of Europe's oldest festivals for documentary, animated and short films, held in Kraków since 1961 in cinemas and online (66th edition ran 31 May to 7 June 2026).
items.industry: KFF Industry with Doc Lab Poland and Animated in Poland presentations and awards.

items.name: Warsaw Film Festival (WIFF)
items.focus: International festival of new features, shorts and documentaries, held every October in Warsaw (41st edition ran 10 to 19 October 2025).

items.name: Transilvania International Film Festival (TIFF)
items.focus: Romania's largest film festival, with an international competition for first and second features and open-air screenings in Cluj (130,000 attendees at the 25th edition in June 2026).
items.industry: Industry events including Romanian Days (RO Days) and labs for professionals.

items.name: Integrated Systems Europe (ISE)
items.focus: The world's largest professional AV and systems integration show at Fira de Barcelona Gran Via, with a Broadcast Solutions area, a Broadcast AV Summit and the Spark creative production programme.
items.industry: Exhibition (1,751 exhibitors in 2026) with conference tracks and a call for presenters.

items.name: San Sebastián International Film Festival
items.focus: Spain's A-list festival, with an Official Selection plus sections such as New Directors, Zabaltegi-Tabakalera, Culinary Zinema, Klasikoak and the Nest student showcase.
items.industry: Europe-Latin America Co-Production Forum, WIP Latam and WIP Europa works-in-progress, Ikusmira Berriak residencies and the Zinemaldia Startup Challenge.
items.submissions: Own entry forms through the My Festival account on sansebastianfestival.com
items.submission_deadline_note: 74th edition: general sections 16 January to 16 June 2026; WIP Latam and WIP Europa 1 June to 1 July 2026; Co-Production Forum 15 April to 15 June 2026

items.name: Sitges Film Festival (International Fantastic Film Festival of Catalonia)
items.focus: The leading festival for fantastic, horror and science-fiction cinema, held in the seaside town of Sitges near Barcelona.
items.industry: Sitges Industry with submissions for projects in development, plus programmes such as WomanInFan.
items.submissions: Festhome and FilmFreeway

photo.author: Juan Pablo Olmo from málaga, spain

items.name: Göteborg Film Festival
items.focus: The largest film festival in the Nordic region, with Nordic and international competitions (266 films from 76 countries in 2026).
items.industry: Nordic Film Market (3 to 5 February 2027) and TV Drama Vision (2 to 3 February 2027); 2,600 accredited delegates in 2026, accreditation opens October 2026.

photo.author: Ronny W (on sv wikipedia and commons).

items.name: Locarno Film Festival
items.focus: Swiss festival of auteur and emerging cinema, known for its open-air Piazza Grande screenings for 8,000 spectators.

items.name: Visions du Réel
items.focus: International festival for creative documentary in Nyon, with international competitions and a public programme.
items.industry: VdR-Industry with VdR-Pitching, VdR-Work in Progress, VdR-Rough Cut Lab, VdR-Development Lab and VdR-Film Market.
items.submissions: Own call for films and projects on visionsdureel.ch (opens 8 September 2026)
items.submission_deadline_note: Early deadline 2 November 2026, final deadline 15 December 2026

items.name: Zurich Film Festival (ZFF)
items.focus: Switzerland's largest audience festival, with a Feature Film Competition, galas and the ZFF Genuss Film strand (programme released 9 September 2026).
items.industry: Zurich Summit industry conference and ZFF accreditations.

items.name: BFI London Film Festival
items.focus: The UK's largest public film festival, presenting new films, series and immersive storytelling across London.
items.industry: LFF Industry programme with industry accreditation and an Industry Forum.

items.name: BSC Expo
items.focus: The British Society of Cinematographers' exhibition of film and TV production equipment and technology at Battersea Evolution.
items.industry: Free-to-register exhibition for cinematographers, camera crews and production professionals.

items.name: Content London
items.focus: C21Media's annual conference on the international scripted and unscripted content business, covering premium IP, studio production and distribution.
items.industry: Registration-based delegate conference with speaker sessions and networking (2026 rate quoted at 1,199 pounds in September).

items.name: Docs Ireland
items.focus: Belfast's documentary festival, screening Irish and international non-fiction at Queen's Film Theatre and other venues.
items.industry: Docs Ireland Marketplace with industry passes, talent development (IGNITE-Docs, Lasair) and the Northern Ireland Screen feature development pitch.
items.submissions: FilmFreeway (filmfreeway.com/DocsIreland)

items.name: Edinburgh International Film Festival (EIFF)
items.focus: Long-running festival for independent cinema, held each August alongside Edinburgh's other festivals (79th edition ran 13 to 19 August 2026).
items.industry: EIFF Industry programme with accreditation; BAFTA and BIFA qualifying festival.
items.submissions: FilmFreeway
items.submission_deadline_note: 2026 edition: submissions opened 6 January 2026 with a final deadline of 17 April 2026; 2027 not yet published

items.name: Edinburgh TV Festival
items.focus: The UK television industry's annual conference, held each August at the Edinburgh International Conference Centre; organisers announced in June 2026 that it will relocate to Manchester in 2027 after 50 years in Edinburgh.
items.industry: Delegate conference with sessions and debate on the television business, plus the TV Foundation's talent schemes.

items.name: MIP London
items.focus: Multi-genre international content market launched in February 2025 as the successor to MIPTV (whose 61st edition in 2024 was its last), held at IET London: Savoy Place and The Savoy Hotel; the 2026 edition ran 22 to 24 February.
items.industry: Market with screenings, showcases and conference sessions ahead of MIPCOM Cannes.

items.name: Media Production & Technology Show (MPTS)
items.focus: Show for media, production and broadcast professionals at the Grand Hall, Olympia London, run by MBI (publisher of Broadcast, Screen International and KFTV).
items.industry: Exhibition and seminar programme; register interest for 2027 on mpts.london.

items.name: Sheffield DocFest
items.focus: The UK's leading documentary festival, screening feature and short non-fiction plus immersive work.
items.industry: Industry programme for documentary professionals with industry accounts and a separate 2027 industry information section.
